extra.final_summary:
Question: average bill_length_mm by island for Adelie penguins.

Data problems found:
- species column had 7 rows with label variants: case/space variants ("Gentoo ", "Chinstrap ", "adelie") and misspellings ("Adeile"→Adelie, "Chinstarp"→Chinstrap, "Gentto"→Gentoo). This affected filtering for Adelie (2 Adelie variants).
- island and bill_length_mm were clean (no missing, no out-of-range 30-60, no duplicates).

Fixes applied:
- normalize_labels on species merging 6 variants into allowed labels Adelie/Chinstrap/Gentoo (approved).

Result (mean bill_length_mm, n=13 Adelie rows):
- Biscoe: 40.93 mm
- Dream: 38.75 mm
- Torgersen: 40.70 mm

Caveats: Other columns have unrelated issues (flipper_length_mm has -200 out-of-range, body_mass_g has comma-formatted text) but they do not affect this question and were left as-is per instructions.

args.reason: Species variants include case/space and misspellings of allowed labels; merging to canonical Adelie/Chinstrap/Gentoo per rules
